results.title: IFLA IT Section | **Absolute Beginners: Multimodal Generative AI for Research, Learning and Creativity (Workshop PDF)** | Facebook
results.content: # IFLA IT Section | **Absolute Beginners: Multimodal Generative AI for Research, Learning and Creativity (Workshop PDF)** | Facebook. **Absolute Beginners: Multimodal Generative AI for Research, Learning and Creativity (Workshop PDF)**. This AI workshop presentation provides an introduction to the field of Generative AI for university research faculty and students who may be absolute beginners to Artificial Intelligence. The materials below may be used as a workshop curriculum guides for library AI literacy programs and targets researchers and specialists in their respective university or research disciplines at varying levels who may be very specialized in their respective academic or professional areas but who may not have used Generative AI but are interested in exploring. This presentation provides a solid basic introduction to exploring foundational AI concepts, touching also on advanced Prompt Engineering techniques with an emphasis on practical applications. This introduction illustrates the transformative potential of AI in various academic disciplines giving researchers the knowledge and tools necessary to leverage generative AI effectively in their academic research, teaching and creative endeavors.
